fact: XML baseCost IS what the player pays for research — but Configurable Techprints ships a dormant rewrite one checkbox from invalidating every cost band
measured_by: BENCH (sonnet agent; the two load-bearing claims re-checked by BENCH)
why_it_matters: RESEARCH_TREE_NORMALIZATION_1 assigns tier from cost band. If anything rescales cost at runtime, the band is a lie for those rows. research_tree_taxonomy.md §4 names this as the band check's known false-pass.

vanilla.verdict: baseCost is what the player pays
evidence: Verse/ResearchProjectDef.cs — the Cost getter returns baseCost directly
RimWorld/ResearchManager.cs — AddProgress / FinishProject / IsFinished all compare against baseCost
CostApparent/ProgressApparent apply CostFactor(TechLevel) to the DISPLAYED number only for a faction below the project's techLevel; never written back, never checked by IsFinished
Difficulty.researchSpeedFactor (ResearchManager.ResearchPerformed) scales the per-tick progress ADDED, not baseCost

the_one_writer.when: Harmony prefix on DefGenerator.GenerateImpliedDefs_PreResolve — load time, once
the_one_writer.gate: only runs when the player enables the 'Modify Base Costs' setting; CTModSettings::SetDefaults has ModifyBaseCosts=false, ResearchBaseCostMultiplier=1.0

state_in_this_install.consequence: runs at defaults = INERT today; costs are untouched

the_one_writer.the_trap: Toggling that one checkbox silently rewrites baseCost across the board and invalidates every tier this pass assigns. Nothing warns; the tier table would simply be wrong. Re-check this fact before trusting any band report, and treat a changed Config folder as invalidating it.
the_one_writer.second_path: ProcessCustomTechprint carries a per-project TechprintData::baseCost override independent of the toggle; the CustomTechprints dict is empty by default and unused here

confidence.configurable_techprints: high — IL-verified write, verified default-off, no settings file on disk
confidence.no_other_writer: medium-high — a static IL sweep cannot catch a write reached by reflection with a runtime-built string. Raising it means a live spot-check: offline baseCost vs a JawaBench read with the full mod list loaded.
